title: The Lost Frequency (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 94bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic lost signal searching
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There is a frequency that no one's broadcasting on right now
It used to carry a voice that I knew how
To find at half past nine on a Tuesday after dark
The lost frequency still lives inside the tuning's mark

[Pre-Chorus]
You can scan the whole dial end to end and come up short
The lost frequency is in a place the dial can't sort

[Chorus]
The lost frequency, the lost frequency
It carried something I was meant to hear
The lost frequency, the lost frequency
Its signal's somewhere in the atmosphere
It moved, it changed, it stepped outside the band
The lost frequency is still transmitting somewhere — and
I'm still trying to receive it with my hand
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
Some signals that we lose are signals that we wanted to keep
They drift beyond the range of what the radio can sweep
The ionosphere at night bends shortwave unexpectedly
And you can hear the stations from the other side of history

[Bridge]
A frequency once lost can reappear years later on
When the conditions change and something in the static's gone
Sparse enough to let the signal through from somewhere far
The lost frequency is out there — you just need the right radar

[Outro]
Lost frequency waiting… still transmitting… still waiting…
That's my boy
